verdict.rationale: The API documents several bulk endpoints: assigning an owner to multiple contacts, marking multiple contacts for 1099 tracking, and bulk update and delete for bank rules. Vendor copy also mentions bulk collection reminders. These are scattered, resource-specific operations rather than a general batch API, and the 100 requests/minute per-organization limit constrains large bulk jobs. Missing for 10: a general-purpose batch/bulk endpoint across item types (invoices, items, transactions), detailed bulk-operation docs beyond endpoint titles, documented bulk support via MCP, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
